about.missionText: As HB Gayrimenkul INTERNATIONAL, our mission is not merely to offer real estate to our clients, but to turn the right investment opportunities into profitable outcomes. We approach every portfolio with professional analysis and aim to achieve maximum results in the shortest possible time through accurate pricing and effective marketing strategies. By providing transparent, reliable, and high-performance consultancy services to both individual and corporate investors, we build long-term business partnerships. Our goal is to become a reference brand in the sector through our transaction-focused approach, strong on-site organization, and expert consultant team. The vision of HB Gayrimenkul INTERNATIONAL is to be a leading brand that elevates real estate consultancy to a new level in Turkey and international markets, recognized for its high sales performance and strong corporate structure.

seo.landingDescription: Independent technical inspection for Turkish real estate: structure, compliance, MEP, and a weighted score with risk context.

seo.requestDescription: Submit your inspection request in minutes. Our team follows up with scheduling and next steps.
seo.sampleTitle: Sample inspection score overview | HB International

seo.faqDescription: Answers about scope, timing, deliverables, and how inspection supports purchase or sale decisions.

landing.heroTitle: Technical property inspection you can act on
landing.heroSubtitle: A structured field review with weighted scoring—so you understand condition, priorities, and risk before you commit capital.
landing.valueBody: Listings and brochures rarely surface latent defects, compliance gaps, or maintenance backlogs. A technical inspection translates the building into a decision-ready view.
landing.whyBody: For buyers and investors it supports price discipline and capex planning. For owners it helps prioritize repairs before listing and reduces renegotiation risk.
landing.check1: Structural safety & visible load path issues
landing.check2: Legal / compliance signals visible on site
landing.step1Text: You share property basics; we confirm scope and timing.
landing.step2Text: Structured checklist by section with notes and photo references.
landing.step3Text: Weighted section scores, total score, and risk band for quick reading.
landing.step4Text: Report handoff and optional walkthrough of major findings.
landing.scoreBody: Sections are weighted (structure heaviest). Each item maps to a quality band; the engine produces section scores, a 1–100-style total, and a risk label such as Strong, Good, Needs Attention, or High Risk. Final decisions should still involve licensed specialists where required.
landing.trustBody: HB International combines operational rigor with multilingual client service across Turkey and Cyprus markets.

faqInline.a1: No. The report is a technical opinion based on visible evidence at inspection time. Engineers or lawyers may be needed for definitive structural or title matters.
faqInline.a2: Timing depends on access and property size. After the site visit, drafting and quality review typically follow a clear internal SLA.
faqInline.a3: Yes. Many clients use inspections to validate off-plan or distant acquisitions alongside documentation review.
faqInline.a4: Scope can be adapted; share asset type and we confirm checklist coverage.
faqInline.q5: What if urgent issues are found?
faqInline.a5: Critical findings are flagged in the report with recommended specialist follow-up.

faqPage.heading: Property inspection FAQ
faqPage.a1: Owners preparing to list, buyers before offer, agents managing due diligence, and investors validating remote acquisitions.
faqPage.a2: Invasive opening of finishes, legal title review, and laboratory testing unless explicitly agreed in writing.
faqPage.a3: Deliverables are agreed during onboarding; digital report formats are standard.
faqPage.a4: Ask us with the property location—coverage depends on inspector availability and access.
faqPage.a5: Our team works in English, Turkish, and Russian across client touchpoints where available.
faqPage.q6: How do I prepare the property?
faqPage.a6: Ensure access to meters, roof if applicable, and main service areas. Tenanted units may need coordination.

seo.landingTitle: Home Staging & Renovation Services | HB International
seo.landingDescription: Sell or rent faster with staging, light renovation, professional media, and premium listing content.
seo.requestTitle: Request staging or renovation | HB International
seo.requestDescription: Tell us about your property and goals—we respond with scope options and next steps.
seo.projectsDescription: Published before-and-after transformations and case highlights from HB staging projects.

landing.heroSubtitle: Buyers scroll fast. Staging, renovation, and premium visuals help listings earn attention, trust, and stronger offers.
landing.whyBody: Well-presented homes signal care, reduce perceived risk, and make online discovery work harder for you—especially in competitive districts.
landing.blockStagingBody: Furniture planning, styling, and decluttering guidance so spaces read larger and more premium on photos and viewings.
landing.blockRenoBody: Targeted cosmetic upgrades—paint, minor repairs, kitchens/baths where ROI is clear—without open-ended builds.
landing.blockPremiumBody: Photography, video, drone, 360° tours, and floor plans that match how international buyers evaluate listings today.
landing.packagesEmpty: Packages are loading or will appear once configured in our system.
landing.budgetBody: Ranges depend on property size, scope, and speed. Share your goal—we propose a tier that matches urgency and ROI.

showcase.title: Before / After transformation
showcase.subtitle: A presentation-led upgrade helps buyers understand potential faster, trust the asset more readily, and move toward stronger sale or rental decisions with less friction.
showcase.previewTitle: A premium transformation standard, made visible
showcase.previewBody: This comparison preview uses curated public imagery to demonstrate the quality bar we target for staging and renovation-led presentation work.
showcase.defaultProjectSummary: Published projects combine staging direction, renovation scope, and premium listing content into a tighter market-ready story.

faqInline.q1: Is staging only for luxury homes?
faqInline.a1: No. Even modest apartments benefit from decluttering, styling, and strong photography.
faqInline.q2: Can you work with tenants in place?
faqInline.a2: Yes, with coordination. Scope may focus on removable styling and content that respects occupancy.
faqInline.a3: We can coordinate trusted partners for agreed scopes; details are confirmed before work starts.
faqInline.a4: Often within days of staging completion, depending on crew availability and property access.

faqPage.heading: Staging & renovation FAQ
faqPage.q1: What is included in premium content?
faqPage.a1: Typically professional photography, with optional video, drone, 360 tours, and floor plans depending on package.
faqPage.a2: Most staging uses local rental inventory and styling props; specifics depend on city and timeline.
faqPage.q3: Can investors use this for rental units?
faqPage.a3: Yes—goals differ from resale, but presentation still improves listing performance and tenant quality.
faqPage.a4: Indicative ranges are confirmed after a short qualification call and optional site photos.
faqPage.a5: No. Many projects are staging-only or media-only if the asset is already in good condition.
faqPage.a6: Primarily Turkey and Cyprus markets; ask for other locations.
